The v1.2.1 exec-on-read RCE was published 2026-06-10 as GHSA-hf25-j9h5-5vq5 (CVSS 7.8 High, CWE-78/94). Source record: docs/security/advisory-exec-on-read-rce.md.

SCOPING DECISION (reusable for future Reverie advisories): published as a GENERAL advisory — ecosystem "other", name "reverie", NOT an npm package advisory. Reason: @seabear/reverie is never published to npm (squatting reservation only, see project.distributionChannels), so an npm-ecosystem GHSA would point Dependabot at a package nobody can depend on and falsely imply it shipped/was-patched on npm. Real channels are GitHub binaries + Homebrew, which GHSA ecosystems don't cover — "other" is the honest representation.

API GOTCHAS creating via `gh api --method POST repos/OWNER/REPO/security-advisories`: (1) `vulnerabilities` array is REQUIRED — each needs package.{ecosystem,name}; use ecosystem "other" for a general advisory. (2) Cannot pass both `severity` and `cvss_vector_string` — pass only the vector, GitHub derives severity+score. (3) Created in `state:"draft"`; publish with a second PATCH `-f state=published`.
